question: What claim about scope requires the total field-group to belong to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs together?
premises: There are yoginīs who move on earth and yoginīs who move in the sky.
All of these are included without exception.
A single field-group belongs to all of them.
inference: The complete field-group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
plain_english: The whole field-group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
